Create exactly 16 full-body poses of the ANTLERLESS DOE shown upper center: warm chestnut coat, cream muzzle throat belly and white rump, large pink-lined ears, black eyes and dark hooves, graceful short stylized adult deer proportions.
All 16 animals face toward camera, nose toward bottom of image, symmetric FRONT view. Elevated three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG game camera exactly matching reference. Same warm painted shading, dark chocolate outline, cozy polished chibi RPG style. Upper left light. NOT photorealistic, not pixel art, not flat vector.
Composition: square atlas, EXACTLY FOUR equally spaced columns and FOUR rows, one animal per invisible cell, all same body size, fixed camera and orientation. Keep entire antlers ears tails hooves within each cell with generous transparent margin. No ground/shadow. Genuine alpha transparent background, no checkerboard drawn.

Row3: idle attentive standing; identical idle with eyes closed blinking; lower neck to graze; nose down grazing ground.

Constraints: recognizable SAME animal every cell; same coat markings, anatomy, scale and antler branching shape. No other animals, person, terrain, props, text, labels, cell borders or watermark. All 16 full silhouettes must be separate and complete.

corrections.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate production transparent game sprite sheet for the ANTLERED STAG from approved reference, which supplies exact character design and illustration style only. This sheet is specifically the REAR THREE QUARTER NORTHWEST view: stag facing AWAY FROM VIEWER toward upper left at 45 degrees. Camera sees white rump CLOSEST at lower right, back, hind legs, back of neck and backs of antlers, ears, muzzle pointed upper left. Not side profile and not front view. Warm chestnut coat cream rump and underside, branching brown antlers, dark hooves; dark chocolate outlines, warm detailed painted chibi woodland RPG shading matching reference exactly.
Square 4 columns by 4 rows sprite atlas. EXACTLY 16 separate complete full-body poses, uniform body size/camera/antler shape. IMPORTANT make animals SMALLER WITHIN CELLS: at least 25 clear transparent pixels beyond EVERY antler tip and hoof; never touch outside sheet edge or adjacent sprite. No grounding shadows, no background, genuine alpha.
Left to right:
Row1 4-frame WALK cycle, alternating quadruped leg contacts and passing poses.
Row2 4-frame GALLOP run, compress then push then stretch airborne then land.
Row3 standing idle, blinking, lowering head to graze, grazing.
Row4 mild flinch, recovery, falling to side non-graphic, lying still on side.
No text, grid lines, scenery, people, other animals, blood or wounds. Maintain NORTHWEST away-facing orientation even grazing and fall. Preserve stag identity and recognizable branching antlers consistently.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game sprite atlas of the ANTLERLESS DOE from approved reference. Use reference for exact chestnut coat, cream muzzle throat belly and white rump, pink-lined ears, dark eyes and hooves, rounded stylized adult deer anatomy and dark outlined painted warm RPG artwork. NO ANTLERS.
This is the REAR THREE QUARTER NORTHWEST view: deer facing AWAY from viewer toward upper left, nose diagonally upper left. Camera sees WHITE RUMP nearest at lower right, back and hindlegs, back of neck, backs of ears, muzzle mostly hidden beyond head. NO smiling face turned toward camera, not front or plain side profile.
Square 4x4 atlas, exactly16 separate full-body poses. One per invisible cell, uniform body size and camera. Generous true transparent margin around every silhouette, no sprite touches neighbor or outer edge. Upper left warm light, preserve detailed painted shading and chocolate outline. No shadows/ground.
Row1 left to right: 4-frame walking cycle alternating quadruped leg contacts and passing.
Row2: 4-frame run gallop, compressed, push, airborne stretch, land.
Row3: standing idle, blink, lowering head to graze, grazing.
Row4: gentle hit flinch, recover, fall onto side, lying still non-graphic.
Keep NORTHWEST away-facing direction across poses. No text, grid, terrain, person, other animals, blood or wounds. Genuine transparent alpha.

No plate, background, scenery, text, shadows outside the food, herb garnish, bones, animal body, face, blood, wounds or UI. This is meat cut food, not a live animal.
